text: answer[math-2f6e0d49-open]: A path from (0,0) to (10,6) contains 16 total unit steps, with exactly 6 upward steps. Choosing the positions of those upward steps gives the binomial coefficient C(16,6), which equals 8008. Thus the number of lattice paths is 8008. This counts each distinct ordering of the required right and up moves exactly once, with no additional constraints.
